description: This file defines the LogNode interface used for a flexible logging system, specifying a method for outputting log messages and exceptions. It serves as a part of a chain of log nodes that can process or filter log data in an Android application.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging node that can output log data and pass it along a chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
